It took six years for Nikita to have her story heard before a court. Eight days of evidence, three days of closing speeches, six hours of jury deliberation. A hairdresser, and a mother-of-one, up against one of the highest paid athletes in the world. But at last, justice has been served. Nikita described the last six years as a “nightmare”, and thanked everyone who stood by her side throughout the whole ordeal.
